sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to get into arguments today, predicts Ganesha. You should avoid any open confrontation. Legal disputes may bother you as well. Try your hand at meditation or resort to music of your preference to relax and unwind. It is best if you delay the start of any important activity today, suggests Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: You might not have heard from a close friend in a long time and worry a little, Taurus. Perhaps this person wasn't well the last time you talked. If you can, it might be a good idea to call. Strange and unsettling dreams could plague your sleep tonight, but don't get too agitated. They aren't prophetic in any way. The symbols probably represent nothing more than psychic detritus released through sleep.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Following your intuition may not be enough to get where you want to be, sweet Taurus. As Venus aligns with the Nodes of Fate, destiny is seized through careful planning and hard work. Outline a structured agenda to build from, trusting your instincts when it is time to improvise. Reworking strategies will open the door to innovative breakthroughs, thanks to a supportive aspect between the Sagittarius Sun and Neptune. These vibes also bring an extra dose of power to your visualization or meditation practices, guiding you toward transformation. Your focus sharpens as Luna moves through your sign, though unbalanced aspects with the Nodes of Fate and Venus urge you to slow down and rest if you begin to hit a wall.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Support of highly influential people will give a big boost to your moral. Your idea of ​​saving money for yourself can be accomplished today. Today you will be able to save appropriately. Complete pending work before your boss takes a note of it. Travel opportunities should be explored. Your marriage will take a beautiful turn on this day.

todo.t: You should avoid any open confrontation.
Try your hand at meditation or resort to music of your preference to relax and unwind.

readings.text: You may rework on an old project in the first half of the day and may even change a plan after that all of a sudden. This is perhaps because you are not happy with your current responsibilities. However, it’s safer to put your mind to complete the tasks on hand.

Be careful at work today because someone will try to manipulate you in some way. Most likely, a co-worker of yours will try to "pull rank" and make it seem as if he or she knows more than you do. Don't be fooled. Ultimately, trust only yourself.

bits.t: As Venus aligns with the Nodes of Fate, destiny is seized through careful planning and hard work.
Complete pending work before your boss takes a note of it.

readings.text: Today is not much in your favour in financial maters. You may be working on long-term financial planning. You may realise that it’s necessary to have stability and security at least in case of finances.

You may need more than ever to spend time focusing the lens on your goals. These aspects can create wonderful ideas or just downtime to ponder and woolgather. Future-oriented thoughts and ideas are featured as you think about how to take them to a wider and more profitable market. It will affect your house of travel, learning, teaching, publishing, spirituality, and the law. You're coming into your own one step at a time.

bits.t: Your idea of ​​saving money for yourself can be accomplished today.

readings.text: Keep your mind in a balanced state. This would ensure that your energy is not channelized in any wrong direction. Besides, controlling mind is also the best way to get rid of old habits. You can take strong decisions and shun bad habits.

Today you may want two opposite things at the same time: a good workout followed by some chocolate cake! Crazier things have happened! The planetary alignment impels you to desire comfort and security (your usual routine, comfort from approval and other good feelings) on one hand, yet on the other, you think it would be erotic and fun to stay up late and do things that give immediate, "sinful" pleasure. The challenge is to find the middle ground and suspend judgment.

lucky.remedy: Keep a black and white piece of cloth in your pocket/wallet for success in your career.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: If you're contemplating being a matchmaker, today might be the perfect day.
